description: A 3-axis analog accelerometer breakout (ADXL3xx family). X, Y and Z are voltages that change as you tilt it: about half the supply when level, higher or lower as you tilt.
how_to_use: Pins in a row: ST (self-test, leave unconnected), Z, Y, X, GND, VCC (3.3 V). Read X/Y/Z with analogRead(). Arduino's example plugs the breakout straight into A0–A5 and powers it from A4/A5 set as outputs; wiring VCC to 3.3V and GND to GND does the same.

plain.what: Senses tilt and movement in three directions (left–right, forward–back, up–down).
plain.how: VCC to 3.3V, GND to GND, and X, Y, Z to three analog pins. Tilt it and the three readings change.
